summary: The `PrfAssignedDestinations` is a partial class part of the `HSPnet.UserControls.StaffProfile` namespace, designed to manage and present assigned destinations for staff within a web application. It integrates UI controls like GridView and Label to display data and provide user feedback.
purpose: To manage and present a list of assigned destinations for staff members, incorporating interaction with user sessions and providing visual feedback on data availability.

workflows.name: Data Binding for Grid View
steps: GridView is bound to data source dsAssignedSSD.
On data bound, gvSSDs_DataBound method checks if any rows are present.
If no rows, lbNone label is made visible.

business_rules: If UserSession is null, cancel the data selection event.
conditions: If gvSSDs has no rows, set lbNone.Visible to true.
If UserSession is null, cancel the ObjectDataSourceSelecting event.
system_behavior: Controls user interface elements based on data availability.
Cancels data selection when user session is not present.
dependencies: UserSession must be available for data selection.
StaffID must be set for retrieving assigned destinations.
exceptions: Data selection is cancelled if user session is unavailable.
